title: Study B simulated-analyst role card
description: Blank schema for one simulated-analyst role card under protocol study-b-sim-1. A document that validates against this schema is a role configuration. It is not a human analyst, not Annotator A or Annotator B, and not a results record. Do not store session outcomes, timings, SUS, or workload in a role card.

roleId.description: Stable id stored in decision-ledger actor fields. Personal names are not role ids.

label.description: Short role label, for example the junior software engineer, mid-level requirements analyst, or senior formal methods card named in the protocol.

skillClaims.description: What this role is assumed to know. Skill claims license technical form of already authorized facts.

maySupply.description: Edits and judgements this role may add without inventing a stakeholder fact.

mustNotInvent.description: Business facts, labels, and scores this role must not create.

acknowledgements.description: The five tokens are mandatory as a set. uniqueItems with minItems and maxItems of 5, over this five-value enum, admits only a permutation of the full set. The tokens restate the protocol hard rules on the card itself.
